content.text:
I can’t log in for you or handle your password, but here’s how you can sign in to OneDrive:

### Sign in on the web
1. Go to **onedrive.com**.
2. Click **Sign in**.
3. Enter your **Microsoft account email** — Outlook, Hotmail, Live, or your work/school email.
4. Enter your password and complete any security verification.

Microsoft also says you can sign in through **microsoft365.com**, then choose **OneDrive** from the app launcher. ([support.microsoft.com](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/open-onedrive-and-upload-files-6e90fbe7-6c87-4eba-bc1b-1b91f59936f0?utm_source=openai))

### Sign in on Windows
1. Click the **OneDrive cloud icon** in the taskbar.
2. If prompted, enter your Microsoft email and password.
3. Choose which folders you want to sync.

If the OneDrive icon is gray or has a line through it, Microsoft says that means you’re not signed in; click it and enter your email and password at the **Set up OneDrive** screen. ([support.microsoft.com](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/can-t-sign-in-to-onedrive-3f99e6e3-042e-49a3-897a-8b7fb0fb8477?utm_source=openai))

### If you forgot your password
Use Microsoft’s sign-in recovery/help page for your Microsoft account. Microsoft notes that personal and work/school accounts may have different recovery steps. ([support.microsoft.com](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/4028195/microsoft-account-sign-in?utm_source=openai))

If you tell me what device you’re using — **Windows, Mac, iPhone, Android, or browser** — I can walk you through the exact steps.
